recipes.name: Magmawake Inscription
recipes.host: One existing caster main-hand weapon; the custom inscription host is supplied separately and not consumed.
recipes.wearer_gate: Character level 60 or higher and native ability to equip the existing host under its class, level, skill, and proficiency rules. Naturally know and be permitted to cast a direct hostile Fire spell and a direct hostile spell of a different native school; no spell is granted. recipes.artisan_gate: Custom Runesmithing career rating at least 450 with this transferable pattern learned; useful-work mastery only, performed at a city workshop. mechanic.trigger: During hostile NPC combat, complete two direct hostile spell casts of different native schools against the same hostile NPC within 8 seconds; one cast must be Fire school.

maintenance.durability: The host remains ordinary durable equipment; only the signature is charged.
maintenance.zero_charge_behavior: At zero charges the rune is inert; the host remains usable and keeps its normal equipment behavior.
maintenance.identity: Charge count and ICD remain bound to this item and wearer family through trade, equip swaps, and relog; swaps cannot reset them.

recipes.teaching: A transferable Magmawake pattern blueprint is proposed as loot only after an eligible character participates in the exact Ragnaros encounter and victory is recorded. recipes.maker_reward: One proposed mastery credit only for a completed paid useful order with inputs and result receipted and returned to the requester on an approved existing host. Guild or same-account supply is allowed. A credit requires a distinct useful order or a materially new inscription revision; no-op reapplications, authorship, idle time, relic pickup, and recycling earn nothing. recipes.bot_rules: Craft only at a city workshop with the qualified artisan present, safe, and supplied with the reserved bill; elapsed time is active workshop time. Signatures work against any eligible genuine hostile NPC; source encounter rules gate only proposed blueprint and relic acquisition.
recipes.abuse_rules: Require two distinct native hostile spell schools against one hostile NPC, including Fire, then consume the primed state on one completed Fire cast. recipes.name: Earthshaker Countermark Inscription
recipes.host: One existing melee weapon; the custom inscription host is supplied separately and not consumed.
recipes.wearer_gate: Character level 70 or higher and native ability to equip the existing host under its class, level, skill, and proficiency rules. Naturally meet the melee-special and weapon proficiency requirements of the host; no skill or attack is granted. The existing host and wearer role must pass a reviewed per-host effect-power budget; if no compatible role/budget is admitted, the inscription cannot be attached.
recipes.artisan_gate: Custom Runesmithing career rating at least 450 with this transferable pattern learned; useful-work mastery only, performed at a city workshop. This custom career grants no native profession skill, character XP, class ability, or bypass of host requirements; the artisan need not visit the source encounter.

mechanic.trigger: During hostile NPC combat, voluntarily close at least 8 m toward one hostile NPC within 3 seconds, then land a melee special on that same NPC within 4 seconds.
mechanic.effect: The impact opens a self-only attack-tempo window; it causes no quake, slow, area damage, or forced movement.
mechanic.numbers: 8% attack speed for 3 seconds; one window per eligible ICD.
mechanic.maintenance: Ordinary durable signature; no charge meter or refill chore.

maintenance.durability: Ordinary durable inscription; no charge meter or compulsory refill.
maintenance.zero_charge_behavior: Not applicable; the signature remains available under its item-family ICD.
maintenance.identity: The ICD remains bound to this item and wearer family through trade, equip swaps, and relog; swaps cannot reset it.

recipes.teaching: A transferable Earthshaker Countermark pattern blueprint is proposed as loot only after an eligible character participates in the exact Doomwalker encounter and victory is recorded. A city artisan can study it once at a workshop without visiting the world-boss site. The separate Doomwalker Stone Heart Relic is consumed once per commission; this is future custom loot, not an existing drop.
recipes.maker_reward: One proposed mastery credit only for a completed paid useful order with inputs and result receipted and returned to the requester on an approved existing host. Guild or same-account supply is allowed. A credit requires a distinct useful order or a materially new inscription revision; no-op reapplications, authorship, idle time, relic pickup, and recycling earn nothing. Counts toward proposed specialization or alphabet teaching.
